312-young-adventure-a-book-of-poems.creator: Stephen Vincent Benet
312-young-adventure-a-book-of-poems.description: A book by Stephen Vincent Benet. at the era which has recently closed was itself marked by a mad idealisation of all novelties. In the literary movements of the last decade --when, indeed, any movement at all has been perceptible -- we have witnessed a bewildering rise and fall of methods and ideals.

arxiv-2111-11411.title: Effects of Graph Network Connections on The Efficiency of Quantum Annealing
arxiv-2111-11411.creator: Atalay Ege, Özgür E. Müstecaplıoğlu
arxiv-2111-11411.description: Abstract Graph structure of quantum spin networks plays an essential role in applying quantum annealing (QA). The Ising model is the typical choice to describe the interactions between the spins in the networks. Here, we explore the interplay of different interaction types between the spins and the structure of the underlying network on the performance of QA.

arxiv-2311-17378.title: The Milky Way Tomography with Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam. I. Halo substructures
arxiv-2311-17378.creator: Yoshihisa Suzuki, Masashi Chiba, Yutaka Komiyama, Kohei Hayashi, Masayuki Tanaka, Tetsuya Fukushima, Scott G. Carlsten, Akira Tokiwa, Tian Qiu and Masahiro Takada
arxiv-2311-17378.description: Abstract We analyze the photometric data in the Wide layer of the Hyper Suprime-Cam Subaru Strategic Program (HSC-SSP) over ∼ 1,200 \sim 1,200 deg 2 to uncover new halo substructures beyond the distance, D ⊙ ∼ D_{\odot}\sim 30 kpc, from the Sun.

arxiv-2410-19503.title: SWITCH : Studying with Teacher for Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
arxiv-2410-19503.creator: Jahyun Koo, Yerin Hwang, Yongil Kim, Taegwan Kang, Hyunkyung Bae, Kyomin Jung
arxiv-2410-19503.description: Abstract Despite the success of Large Language Models (LLMs), they still face challenges related to high inference costs and memory requirements. To address these issues, Knowledge Distillation (KD) has emerged as a popular method for model compression, with the use of student-generated outputs (SGOs) as training data being particularly notable for reducing the mismatch between training and inference.

arxiv-2503-07691.title: Fair Text Classification via Transferable Representations
arxiv-2503-07691.creator: Thibaud Leteno thibaud.leteno@univ-st-etienne.fr, Michael Perrot michael.perrot@inria.fr, Charlotte Laclau charlotte.laclau@telecom-paris.fr, Antoine Gourru antoine.gourru@univ-st-etienne.fr, Christophe Gravier christophe.gravier@univ-st-etienne.fr
arxiv-2503-07691.description: Abstract Group fairness is a central research topic in text classification, where reaching fair treatment between sensitive groups (e.g., women and men) remains an open challenge. We propose an approach that extends the use of the Wasserstein Dependency Measure for learning unbiased neural text classifiers.

arxiv-2505-08890.title: On the three-point functions in timelike 𝒩 = 1 \mathcal{N}=1 Liouville CFT
arxiv-2505-08890.creator: ​​ Beatrix Mühlmann, ​​, Vladimir Narovlansky, ​​, Ioannis Tsiares
arxiv-2505-08890.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by ​​ Beatrix Mühlmann, ​​, Vladimir Narovlansky, ​​, Ioannis Tsiares. We use analytic (super-)conformal bootstrap methods to derive explicit expressions for the structure constants of 𝒩 = 1 \mathcal{N}=1 Liouville CFT in the ‘timelike’ regime of the superconformal central charge. The obtained expressions take the form of inverses of the appropriate spacelike counterparts, which we explain concretely by elucidating the analytic properties of the corresponding shift relations in the NS- and R-sectors for the normalization-independent bootstrap data on the sphere.

arxiv-2508-02413.title: Improving Knowledge Graph Understanding with Contextual Views - Extended
arxiv-2508-02413.creator: Antrea Christou, Cogan Shimizu
arxiv-2508-02413.description: Abstract Navigating, visualizing, and discovery in graph data is frequently a difficult prospect. This is especially true for knowledge graphs (KGs), due to high number of possible labeled connections to other data. However, KGs are frequently equipped with an ontology as a schema. That is, it informs how the relationships between data may be constrained.
